alt: Two panels. A pattern is a regular relationship at one point in time, shown as grouped bars where one group is always higher. A trend is a general direction over time, shown as one rising and one falling line. Below: describe it, quote figures with units and note exceptions.
caption: A pattern compares groups at one time; a trend follows change over time.

after: ## A routine for any data item
alt: Seven numbered steps: read the title, check the units, check the source and sample, find the overall pattern or trend, quote figures, note exceptions, and ask what the data cannot show.
caption: Check what the data measure before describing them, and what they miss before concluding.
